decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a niche maritime option with long naval procurement cycles, so its value is still uncertain, and the low cost of keeping it listed alongside the firm's maritime expertise justifies keeping it open despite only a minor website mention.
The medical examination light has its own page and diversifies the firm into institutional healthcare markets, where demand is still unresolved and holding costs are low, so the option stays open.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit the firm's core industrial business and certified manufacturing, have a page of their own and long certification-driven lifecycles, so there is little reason to abandon them.

The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product with proven demand, so much of the uncertainty is resolved favourably and keeping it costs little, though as a design item outside the core it carries some pruning risk.
